description: Backend routing-mode plumbing that REUSES the existing RoutingHint bias. Introduce a per-conversation RoutingMode (Auto / PreferLocal / PreferQuality / Manual) that maps to the existing domain::RoutingHint knob, persist it per conversation, thread the effective hint into the pipeline's RoutingRequest, and make the auto policy honor a conversation-level hint with precedence over the persona hint. The privacy fail-closed hard constraint (LocalOnly/Confidential -> local only) MUST remain unoverridable by any mode. Add a Tauri command to set the mode and unit tests including a test proving Prefer-Quality/Manual cannot override a LocalOnly tag. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: In crates/domain/src/models.rs add a new enum `RoutingMode` with variants Auto, PreferLocal, PreferQuality, Manual; derive Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize with #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] (serializes as auto/preferLocal/preferQuality/manual). Add a method `RoutingMode::effective_hint(&self) -> Option<domain::RoutingHint>` mapping Auto->None, PreferLocal->Some(RoutingHint::PreferLocal), PreferQuality->Some(RoutingHint::PreferQuality), Manual->None (Manual defers to the per-conversation pin / per-message override, so it contributes no automatic bias). Add a doc comment noting that a FUTURE continuous slider could map onto the same RoutingHint bias with no backend change (design note only; do NOT build a slider).

Add `pub routing_mode: Option<RoutingMode>` to the `Conversation` struct in crates/domain/src/models.rs (Option so older rows without the column default to None == Auto). Keep #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]; add #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] so an absent mode is omitted from JSON and old configs load. Update the existing Conversation round-trip test and any struct literals in the domain tests to include routing_mode: None.

Add a sqlx migration crates/persistence/migrations/0002_conversation_routing_mode.sql: `ALTER TABLE conversations ADD COLUMN routing_mode TEXT;` (JSON: Option<RoutingMode>, nullable, no default so existing rows read NULL == None). Migrations are additive and idempotent via sqlx.

In crates/persistence/src/repositories.rs update ConversationRepo::insert (add routing_mode to the column list, the VALUES placeholders, and bind opt_to_json(&c.routing_mode)?), ConversationRepo::update (add `routing_mode = ?` to the SET list and bind it), and row_to_conversation (read the routing_mode TEXT column and opt_from_json::<RoutingMode>). Follow the exact pattern already used for conversation_pref. Update the existing persistence tests that build Conversation literals to include routing_mode. Add/extend a repo test that persists a routing_mode and reads it back.

In crates/orchestrator-core/src/session.rs add `set_conversation_routing_mode(&self, id: Uuid, mode: Option<RoutingMode>) -> Result<Conversation, SessionError>` implemented via the existing mutate_conversation closure (set c.routing_mode = mode), mirroring set_conversation_route. Add RoutingMode to the crate re-exports if needed (orchestrator-core re-exports domain). Update any session.rs test Conversation literals for the new field.

In crates/routing/src/policy.rs extend RoutingRequest with a new field `pub routing_hint: Option<domain::RoutingHint>` documented as the CONVERSATION-LEVEL effective routing bias (from the per-conversation routing mode) that takes precedence over the persona hint when set; None means fall back to the persona hint. Keep RoutingRequest non-Serialize (unchanged). Update all RoutingRequest struct literals in the routing crate's own tests to set routing_hint: None.

In crates/routing/src/policies/auto_default.rs change the line that currently reads `let hint = req.persona.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.routing_hint);` to prefer the conversation-level hint: `let hint = req.routing_hint.or_else(|| req.persona.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.routing_hint));`. This reuses the SAME existing bias mechanism (quality_weight/cost_weight blend + the PreferLocal nudge). Do NOT touch filter_candidates: the privacy hard constraint runs there BEFORE any hint bias and must stay fail-closed. Confirm the rationale builder still receives this effective hint.

In crates/orchestrator-core/src/pipeline.rs run_turn, after loading the conversation, compute the conversation-level effective hint: `let conversation_hint = conversation.routing_mode.and_then(|m| m.effective_hint());` and set `routing_hint: conversation_hint` in the RoutingRequest literal (alongside the existing fields). Add a brief comment that Manual mode maps to None here and the manual pin/override precedence is handled exactly as before via conversation_pref / manual_override. Update the pipeline test(s) that build RoutingRequest or Conversation to include the new field.

In crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs add `set_conversation_routing_mode` #[tauri::command] (with a `set_conversation_routing_mode_inner` testable body, following the set_conversation_route pattern): parse the conversation id, accept `mode: Option<RoutingMode>` (validated by enum membership via serde deserialization), delegate to SessionManager::set_conversation_routing_mode, return the updated Conversation. Import RoutingMode. Register the command in crates/tauri-app/src/lib.rs generate_handler! list. Add unit tests: (a) set_conversation_routing_mode persists PreferLocal and clears back to Auto/None; (b) a routing test asserting that with a LocalOnly (or Confidential) privacy tag AND routing_mode PreferQuality (and separately a Manual pin to a cloud model), the auto policy still fails closed / never selects a non-local model (reuse the existing auto_default privacy test structure in the routing crate for the policy-level assertion).

Grep for every other RoutingRequest { ... } and Conversation { ... } struct literal across the workspace (crates/*/src and crates/*/tests) and add the new fields so all crates compile. In particular check crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs tests, crates/orchestrator-core tests, crates/routing tests, crates/persistence tests, and any integration tests.

Run `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml --check` for each touched crate (domain, persistence, routing, orchestrator-core, tauri-app) and fix any formatting. Self-audit for clippy -D warnings: no unused imports, no needless borrows, prefer flat doc-comment prose (no nested markdown sub-lists) to avoid clippy::doc_lazy_continuation / doc_overindented_list_items.
acceptance_criteria: domain::RoutingMode exists with camelCase serde (auto/preferLocal/preferQuality/manual) and effective_hint() maps Auto->None, PreferLocal->PreferLocal, PreferQuality->PreferQuality, Manual->None.
Conversation carries an optional routing_mode that round-trips through serde (omitted when None) and through the SQLite migration + ConversationRepo insert/update/read.
SessionManager::set_conversation_routing_mode and the set_conversation_routing_mode Tauri command exist, are registered in the invoke handler, and persist + clear the mode.
RoutingRequest carries a conversation-level routing_hint; auto_default uses it with precedence over the persona hint; the pipeline populates it from the conversation's routing_mode.
A test proves that under a LocalOnly/Confidential tag, PreferQuality (and a Manual cloud pin) cannot cause selection of a non-local model (privacy stays fail-closed).
All touched crates pass `cargo fmt --check`; every RoutingRequest/Conversation literal in the workspace compiles with the new fields.
verification: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/domain/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/persistence/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/routing/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/orchestrator-core/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/tauri-app/Cargo.toml --check all exit 0

Inspection: grep confirms auto_default.rs uses req.routing_hint.or_else(persona hint) and filter_candidates (privacy) is unchanged; pipeline.rs sets routing_hint from conversation.routing_mode.effective_hint(); migration 0002 adds the routing_mode column; repositories.rs binds/reads it; lib.rs registers set_conversation_routing_mode.
CI (authoritative): per-crate cargo build/clippy/test pass on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest, including the new privacy-fail-closed and routing-mode persistence tests.
findings:
Implemented the full backend routing-mode plumbing on branch phase-7-ux-refactor.

Changes:
- domain/src/models.rs: added RoutingMode enum {Auto, PreferLocal, PreferQuality, Manual} with #[serde(rename_all=camelCase)] (serializes auto/preferLocal/preferQuality/manual) and effective_hint() mapping Auto->None, Manual->None, PreferLocal->Some(PreferLocal), PreferQuality->Some(PreferQuality), plus a design note that a future continuous slider maps onto the same RoutingHint knob with no backend change. Added Conversation.routing_mode: Option<RoutingMode> with #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if=Option::is_none)]. Added serde/effective_hint/round-trip tests and updated the existing conversation_round_trips literal + omitted-field assertion.
- persistence: new additive migration 0002_conversation_routing_mode.sql (ALTER TABLE conversations ADD COLUMN routing_mode TEXT, nullable, no default). repositories.rs: insert/update/row_to_conversation now bind/read routing_mode via opt_to_json/opt_from_json following the conversation_pref pattern; imported RoutingMode; updated sample_conversation literal; added conversation_routing_mode_round_trips repo test (insert None, set PreferLocal, clear back to None).
- orchestrator-core: session.rs added set_conversation_routing_mode(id, Option<RoutingMode>) via mutate_conversation (mirrors set_conversation_route), updated create_conversation literal, added a session test; lib.rs re-exports RoutingMode; pipeline.rs run_turn computes conversation_hint = conversation.routing_mode.and_then(|m| m.effective_hint()) and sets routing_hint on the RoutingRequest with a comment that Manual/Auto map to None and the pin/override precedence is unchanged; updated tools_bridge.rs + tests/tool_loop.rs Conversation literals.
- routing: policy.rs added RoutingRequest.routing_hint: Option<domain::RoutingHint> (still non-Serialize) documented as the conversation-level bias with precedence over the persona hint; auto_default.rs now uses `let hint = req.routing_hint.or_else(|| req.persona.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.routing_hint));` (filter_candidates privacy logic UNTOUCHED, still fail-closed before any hint). Updated all RoutingRequest literals in signals.rs, manual_override.rs, registry.rs, auto_default.rs tests, and tests/demo_policy_extension.rs. Added auto_default tests: conversation hint precedence over persona hint, PreferQuality cannot override LocalOnly (chooses local), and fails closed under Confidential with no local candidate.
- tauri-app: commands.rs added set_conversation_routing_mode #[tauri::command] + set_conversation_routing_mode_inner (accepts Option<RoutingMode>, validated by serde enum membership), imported RoutingMode; registered in lib.rs generate_handler!. Added command test (persists PreferLocal, clears to None, rejects bad id) and a policy-level test proving PreferQuality + a Manual cloud pin cannot override a LocalOnly tag (auto stays local; manual pin rejected with ManualRouteRejected).

Privacy fail-closed guarantee preserved: filter_candidates untouched; the new hint only biases ranking AFTER the hard-constraint filter. Conversation-level hint takes precedence over persona hint; Manual maps to no automatic hint (None).

Self-check results: `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml --check` passes (exit 0) for domain, persistence, routing, orchestrator-core, tauri-app. Grepped the workspace: every RoutingRequest{} literal now sets routing_hint and every Conversation{} literal sets routing_mode. Clippy -D warnings self-audited by inspection (no unused imports; removed a redundant inner RoutingHint import and needless clones in the new test; doc comments use flat prose). Offline network mode (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) prevents cargo build/clippy/test; those defer to CI on ubuntu-latest + windows-latest. Frontend TS mirror (RoutingMode union + Conversation field + setConversationRoutingMode wrapper) is FEAT-003's scope, not touched here.
